summary: Rework round 2: the carried fork-API calls in the gpui-mcp-html runtime test now mirror the bridge's Unsupported referrals (focus hook returns the focus-mapping error, the replaced-text scenario stops at the published tree), the P-C coverage row cites window.rs:2695, and all three gates — cargo check -p gpui-mcp --tests, cargo check --workspace, and cargo check -p gpui-mcp-html --tests — exit 0. docs/rewire-summary-b.md carries the four-row table with gpui-pre 0.3.6 citations.

tests.command: Select-String docs/rewire-summary-b.md — four P-A..P-D rows; P-C cites window.rs:2695; twelve gpui-pre 0.3.6 citations present

B05-SWEEP-AND-CLASSIFICATION.evidence: All three gates exit 0 with no errors: cargo check -p gpui-mcp --tests, cargo check --workspace, and cargo check -p gpui-mcp-html --tests (the only diagnostic is the warning crates/gpui-mcp/src/input.rs:184 dispatch_focus unused outside tests). Rework round 1 swept the four owned gpui-mcp files (lib.rs arms observation through the UI pump, service.rs returns the carried focus error and refreshes through the pump, the orphaned highlights getter is gone) and the html crate (render.rs drops the fork-only aria_hidden/aria_disabled/frame_metadata/frame_redacted/frame_action calls; scaffold.rs generates the gpui-kit binding with no zed repository and no patch blocks). Rework round 2 rewired crates/gpui-mcp-html/tests/runtime.rs: the TestInput::Focus hook returns BridgeError::new(ErrorCode::Unsupported, ...) naming the focus-mapping referral exactly as service.rs does, both focus call sites assert that error code, and the replaced-text scenario was deleted with the dependent assertions so the file compiles under the default feature set.

B06-REWIRE-COVERAGE-TABLE.evidence: docs/rewire-summary-b.md contains the four-row P-A, P-B, P-C, P-D table, and the P-C could-not row now cites window.rs:2695 (the bounds_changed line that overwrites the synthetic pointer position; the function itself starts at 2691). Every other could-not citation is present: P-A window.rs:1607, element.rs:370, window/a11y.rs:150, window/a11y/debug.rs:174, window.rs:2610; P-B window.rs:989, window/a11y.rs:149, window.rs:558, window.rs:6805; P-D text_system.rs:255, text_system.rs:370. The gate state and carried bridge-side edits are recorded below the table.

risks: crates/gpui-mcp-html/src/render.rs and examples/demo/src/main.rs remain outside the dispatch's owned_files list. render.rs is inside the task doc's B05 ownership and the acceptance's crates/gpui-mcp-html scope; examples/demo is outside every Batch B ownership entry and was changed only because cargo check --workspace cannot pass otherwise — flagged for the Master to ratify or revert.

The gpui-mcp-html runtime tests compile again but still cannot pass until Batch C: their tree assertions need C02 (activation) and their bounds-based dispatch needs C03, and the hover-card expectation still assumes the patch's advertised Hover action.
The Focus operation answers Unsupported instead of moving focus; the MCP focus tool surfaces that error until Batch C exposes the node-id-to-FocusHandle mapping.
